data.name: Sample - Alloy ITSM - 1.0.0
data.description: This connector is designed to manage and automate ticket-based operations. It streamlines the creation, updating, and tracking of tickets, helping improve workflow efficiency and service management.

workflows.name: Get Current User Profile

workflows.description: Retrieve information about Alloy Navigator objects of the specified object class with filtering, sorting, and pagination support
workflows.name: Get Objects

workflows.description: Retrieve Alloy Navigator objects using POST method with advanced filtering operators (=, <>, >, >=, <, <=). Supports complex queries without URL length limitations.
workflows.name: Get Objects Advanced Search

arguments.title: Alloy ITSM: Get Objects Advanced Search

workflows.description: Retrieve all fields of a particular object using its OID or database ID. Returns complete object information in Items array format.

workflows.description: Retrieve activities/history for a specific Alloy Navigator object with filtering, sorting, and pagination support

workflows.description: Retrieve classification/dictionary values for Alloy Navigator objects (e.g., Status values, Types, Priorities). Useful for getting dropdown options and reference field values.

workflows.description: Create a new Alloy Navigator object record via workflow Create Action. Does not support Service Requests (use Submit Request action for Service Catalog Items).

workflows.description: Run a workflow Step Action on an Alloy Navigator object to update fields or trigger workflows. Cannot be used for Software Catalog and Stock Room objects.

workflows.description: Check if a workflow Step Action is available for a specific object. Action availability depends on object type, status, security roles, and other criteria.

arguments.title: Alloy ITSM: Check Step Action Availability
